# Muhammad Hashir - Software Engineer & Full Stack Developer

> Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, NestJS, React Native, and PostgreSQL. Experienced in engineering production web applications, AI-driven integrations, and cross-platform mobile apps.

## Overview
Muhammad Hashir is a Full Stack Software Engineer based in Hyderabad, Sindh, Pakistan with 2+ years of production experience building modern web and mobile applications. He partners with founders, businesses, and engineering teams to turn ideas into scalable, dependable software products.

## Core Technical Skills
- Frontend Development: React 19, Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive UI/UX
- Backend & Systems: NestJS, Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, Microservices, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), JWT Authentication
- Databases & ORM: PostgreSQL, Prisma, TypeORM, SQL query optimization, database modeling
- Mobile Development: React Native, Expo, Cross-Platform iOS & Android development, Native Device APIs
- AI & Automation: Large Language Model (LLM) integrations, agentic workflows, custom AI chatbots, automated data processing pipelines
- Integrations & Tooling: Stripe & multi-gateway payment processing, Git, GitHub, Vercel, Docker basics, Linux, Postman

## Professional Experience
- Full Stack Developer at Samarix (Present): Building scalable full-stack features for AI-driven platforms, optimizing database queries, and delivering responsive modern UI components.
- Full Stack Developer at Zetsol Technologies (1 Year): Developed production web and cross-platform mobile products using NestJS, React, Next.js, and React Native.
- Frontend Developer Intern at Zetsol Technologies (3 Months): Developed Zetsol's official corporate web application, promotional landing pages, and administrative portal components.
